Honest answer? It depends on what matters to you.
The Eco Organic is fine if:
You want certified organic materials at the lowest price
You're okay with a simpler construction (2" latex on top, pocketed coils)
You don't need firmness options (it's one medium feel)
A 10-year warranty and 100-night trial work for you
The Green Mattress is worth it if:
You want more latex (3" total vs 2") for better pressure relief and durability
You care about firmness choice — the Green offers five options (Firm, Medium, Plush, Ultra Plush, Extra Firm) vs just one
You value a longer trial and warranty — 365 nights vs 100, and 25 years vs 10
You want more coils — up to 1,379 fabric-encased coils vs the Eco's simpler system
The Green Mattress has more latex, better coil support, and way more customization. If you're a side sleeper, have specific firmness needs, or plan to keep it 15+ years, the extra $300–$500 pays off. If you just want solid organic sleep without the bells and whistles, the Eco is genuinely good — not a compromise.
